Switching from Windows to Mac doesn't actually impose many software restrictions. Not only can most major PC applications run on this platform, but there are also many exclusive and practical Mac applications available.

The biggest exception is gaming. However, the latest tests show that whether through official or unofficial means, the performance of Windows games running on Mac has reached an all-time best level……

Apple has an exclusive game porting toolkit that helps developers evaluate how their Windows games run on Mac, aiming to encourage and facilitate the porting of games to the Mac platform.

However, as Filipe Esposito of Macworld mentioned, this toolkit is also used by gamers to unofficially run Windows software on Mac——he himself is one of them. He pointed out that the latest test version brings significant performance improvements, using *GTA V* as an example.

After testing Game Porting Toolkit 4 beta for several days on a MacBook Pro equipped with M4 Pro, he found that the performance improvements fundamentally transform the experience of running demanding Windows games……On the same M4 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB memory, using the same game settings and benchmark tests, the frame rate of *GTA V* increased from approximately 106 fps on GPTK 3 to approximately 176 fps on GPTK 4 beta——an increase of about 66%. The game runs quite smoothly at 2K resolution with medium-to-high graphics settings.

He admits that not every game sees such significant improvements, but hopes these developments will encourage game studios to consider Mac as a viable platform.
